comment: Recognition layer 2: community/district entry signs. Coordinates are real lat/lon projected into world space via route origin+scale at load. radius = trigger distance in compressed-world meters. needs_owner_review entries are best-effort from map data — the owner's lived knowledge is authoritative.

communities.name: Palisadoes
communities.note: The narrow causeway linking Norman Manley Airport to Kingston — sea on both sides

communities.name: Harbour View
communities.note: Eastern gateway into Kingston where the Palisadoes meets the city

communities.name: Mountain View
communities.note: East Kingston community along Mountain View Avenue

communities.name: Half Way Tree
communities.note: Kingston's main crossroads — transport hub named for a long-gone cotton tree

communities.name: New Kingston
communities.note: Kingston's modern business and hotel district

communities.name: Portmore
communities.note: Jamaica's largest dormitory city, home to hundreds of thousands

communities.name: Sligoville
communities.note: First free village in Jamaica, established 1835 after Emancipation

communities.name: Bog Walk
communities.note: Town at the southern end of the Rio Cobre gorge

communities.name: Linstead
communities.note: Busy market town — home of the famous Linstead Market song

communities.name: Ewarton
communities.note: Small town in St. Catherine on the way to Moneague

communities.name: Moneague
communities.note: Rural junction town in St. Ann where the hill country begins

communities.name: Mount Rosser
communities.note: Hillside community with steep mountain roads — potential off-road detour zone

communities.name: Angels
communities.note: Small community in St. Ann on the approach to Fern Gully

communities.name: Fern Gully
communities.note: Kilometre-long canopy of bamboo and tree ferns — formerly a riverbed

communities.name: Ocho Rios
communities.note: Tourism capital of Jamaica's north coast — end of the road!
